title: Sour Ukrainian Egg Rolls Bao
description: Crisp, juicy Ukrainian egg rolls in a tangy sauce, served in a slate-tile vessel.
instructions: Preheat the ttukbaegi earthenware cook to 375°F (190°C).
In a large bowl, combine the cabbage, carrots, green onion, and garlic.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, salt, and black pepper.
Add the flour mixture to the cabbage mixture and stir until combined.
Using a food processor or blender, finely chop the cabbage mixture.
Add the chopped cabbage mixture to the sour cream and stir until combined.
In a separate pan, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Using a spatula, carefully place the egg roll wrappers on the pan and brush with olive oil.
When the wrappers are golden brown, flip and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Assemble the bao by placing a tablespoon of the sour cream mixture on the bottom half of a bao bun, followed by a cooked egg roll, and finishing with the top half of the bao bun.
